# Apify Blog

> > The Apify Blog covers web scraping, automation, and AI integration with tutorials on Python, Selenium, Crawlee, and the Apify platform for data extraction and workflow automation.

This blog provides technical guides, case studies, and product updates for developers and businesses using web scraping, data collection, and automation. Content ranges from beginner tutorials to advanced infrastructure insights, featuring the Apify Actor platform, integration with tools like n8n, and real-world applications in social media research, e-commerce, and AI.

## Key Topics

- Web scraping and crawling
- Apify Actor platform
- Python automation (Scrapy, Selenium, Beautiful Soup)
- Anti-blocking techniques (proxies, CAPTCHAs, Cloudflare)
- Data extraction and collection
- Sentiment analysis and NLP
- Social media scraping (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
- AI and LLM integration
- Crawlee framework
- Automated workflows
- JavaScript scraping tools
- E-commerce data (Amazon)
- API development and integration
- Infrastructure monitoring
- No-code automation solutions
